findings: Player.qml anchors VideoSurface across the overlay viewport when controls are unpinned. The bottom bar then covers the lower caption.
The redesigned playback bar supplies its own background but the outer controlBar.background can be invisible, allowing the old bottom fade to darken captions above it.
sub-margin is a saved appearance/preset setting and is expressed in destination pixels; changing it for temporary controls would affect user settings semantics.
libass renders absolute TOP|LEFT regions, including normally styled ASS. A generic relative-bottom margin adjustment alone cannot qualify positioned ASS or preserve all of its layouts.
